2609.16984.title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs
2609.16984.paper_summary: Open-weight language models publish the strings their chat templates use to mark turns, roles and tool results, which the tokenizer maps back to the reserved identifiers the model obeys. Anyone who controls text in a prompt can therefore write a turn boundary indistinguishable from one the serving stack wrote. We audit 256 deployed chat tokenizers. All are forgeable, and the flag usually recommended as a fix leaves 56.6% forgeable because it misses the tool and reasoning markers agent systems rely on. We propose nameless tokenization, which leaves the control entries with a reserved identifier and no surface string, so the content encoder cannot emit one and message content reaches the model unaltered. Across five tokenizer families it reproduces the standard token stream exactly on attack-free data and lifts accuracy on a probe of delimiter-bearing text from 8.5% to 59.9%, where sanitizers lose it. Separating a delimiter's appearance from its identifier shows the identifier matters little against a bare task instruction, but carries most of a forged tool result and most of any forged turn once the system message tells the model to treat user content as data.
2609.16984.paper_summary_zh: 開放權重的語言模型發布它們的聊天模板所使用的字符串，以標記回合、角色和工具結果，這些字符串由分詞器映射回模型遵循的保留識別符。因此，任何控制提示中的文本的人都可以編寫一個與服務堆棧所寫的回合邊界無法區分的邊界。我們審計了256個已部署的聊天分詞器。所有這些都是可偽造的，通常建議作為修復的標誌留下56.6%的可偽造性，因為它錯過了代理系統依賴的工具和推理標記。我們提出了無名分詞，這使得控制條目保留識別符而沒有表面字符串，因此內容編碼器無法發出一個，消息內容可以不被改變地到達模型。在五個分詞器家族中，它在無攻擊數據上準確地重現了標準的標記流，並將對帶有分隔符的文本的探測準確率從8.5%提高到59.9%，而清理器則失去了這一點。將分隔符的外觀與其識別符分開顯示，識別符對於裸任務指令的重要性不大，但在系統消息告訴模型將用戶內容視為數據後，卻承載了大部分偽造工具結果和大部分偽造回合的內容。
